# runr_api_plan (Resource)

A plan of the API product: rate limits and quotas a consumer (`runr_api_consumer`) or an API key (`runr_api_key`) gets ([plans](https://runr.sh/docs/api-product/#plans)). Every limit is optional; the region's gateway-auth enforces them and answers 429 when one is reached. A plan belongs to a gateway or to the organization (offered on every gateway; `api_products.manage`). A plan that a consumer or an active key uses cannot be deleted.

Import with the plan id: `terraform import runr_api_plan.pro 01JP…`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A plan of the gateway: 10 requests per second (bursts of 20) and 100 000 a month.
resource "runr_api_plan" "pro" {
  gateway_id      = runr_gateway.eu.id
  name            = "Pro"
  description     = "For production use"
  rate_per_second = 10
  burst           = 20
  quota_per_month = 100000
}

# A plan of the organization, offered on every gateway (api_products.manage).
resource "runr_api_plan" "trial" {
  name          = "Trial"
  quota_per_day = 1000
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name, unique per gateway (or in the organization).

### Optional

- `burst` (Number) Requests at once of the token bucket (at least `rate_per_second`, at most 1000000). Needs `rate_per_second`. Left out: the rate for a new plan or a changed rate, else the plan's burst stays.
- `description` (String) What the plan offers.
- `gateway_id` (String) Gateway id (`runr_gateway`) the plan belongs to. Left out: a plan of the organization, offered on every gateway. Changing it creates a new plan.
- `quota_per_day` (Number) Requests per calendar day, UTC (1-1000000000000). Left out: no limit of this kind.
- `quota_per_month` (Number) Requests per calendar month, UTC (1-10000000000000). Left out: no limit of this kind.
- `rate_per_minute` (Number) Sliding window, requests per minute (1-10000000). Left out: no limit of this kind.
- `rate_per_second` (Number) Token bucket rate, requests per second (1-100000). Left out: no limit of this kind.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Plan id.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# <plan id> (`runr gateway plans ls` lists them)
terraform import runr_api_plan.pro 01JPLAN0123456789ABCDEFGHJ
```
